text:
The Juniper planning meetings (3–10 Nov) set configuration and ownership for 25 modules. Corrected values include upload batch_size 200, billing 750, ledger 450, quota 900, export 350, session 250, metrics queue_depth 270, media 490, alerts timeout_s 20, and checkout ttl_s 360. Fixed requirements are feed retry_limit 9, sync retry_limit 8, pricing retry_limit 6, and gateway batch_size 450. Reports and profile are owned by gamma, alerts by beta, and metrics by delta.

Checkout and sync, export and feed, catalog and shipping, and billing and checkout must run on separate workers, while shipping and upload share one. Four dependency paths are banned: search→feed, sync→media, session→ledger, and archive→ingest. Rollout order is metrics before reports, feed before scheduler, and quota before session. The security and budget reviews are open items, both scheduled for next Thursday.
